originalRequest: i want a sveltekit spa marketing app for aoi.
subject: Aoi, a private shared space for two people to save moments, exchange thoughtful gestures, make plans, and revisit their history together.
scope: A responsive public marketing page, separate from the existing Expo app. Include navigation and a footer. Keep this first scope to one substantive page with links to existing legal pages.
primaryGoal: Help couples understand Aoi’s value and take a clear next step toward using the app.
audience: Couples who want a private, calm place for their relationship, including couples living apart.
offer: One shared place to keep meaningful moments, send them to a partner, plan time together, and return to what they have built.
primaryAction: Get Aoi, linking only to a verified app entry or store destination when available.
creativeControl: High for page composition, imagery, copy, and motion after reference images are selected; preserve Aoi’s intimate tone and recognizable dark landing identity unless the references support a deliberate evolution.
requiredContent: Hero: Aoi’s private space for two, with a clear value statement and primary action.
The scattered-moments problem: meaningful photos, notes, and ideas become hard to find across chats and other apps.
Keep a moment: show how a photo, note, or small memory becomes part of a shared history.
Share with your partner: explain the value of one person saving something and the other receiving it.
Plan time together: present shared plans and meaningful dates as part of the same relationship space.
Return to your story: show how saved moments become worth revisiting together.
Private by design: explain the two-person setting using only privacy claims verified by the current product and policy.
How it works: create a shared space, invite a partner, then start keeping and revisiting moments.
Closing invitation: restate the benefit and offer the same primary action.
constraints: Use SvelteKit for the marketing interface.
Treat the page as a client-side SPA as requested while keeping public content accessible and discoverable where the framework permits.
Do not use the older marketing documents’ unverified price, guarantee, testimonials, encryption claims, or store availability as current facts.
Use selected reference images for the desktop and mobile composition of every section in the subsequent design phase.
Respect reduced-motion preferences while providing visible entrance and scroll animation by default.
Do not present illustrative memories or people as real Aoi customers.
brandInputs: Existing public app screen: lowercase text wordmark “aoi,” intimate editorial copy, a dark atmospheric backdrop, and restrained motion. Source: app/(public)/index.tsx and components/landing/immersive-hero.tsx.
Existing landing colors: midnight #120D13, light ink #F6EDF3, muted text #C5B2C2, border #5C4255. Source: constants/landing-theme.ts.
Current app theme also uses rose and lavender accents with light and dark surfaces. Source: constants/theme-presets.ts.

Older marketing guidance uses the line “Keep the moments that matter” and describes a private couples app. Source: marketing/01-value-proposition.md. Treat its visual and commercial details as historical guidance rather than confirmed current requirements.
The app ships no custom font binaries; its typography resolves through system stacks. Source: hooks/use-aoi-fonts.ts.
assumptions: This first brief covers a single marketing page rather than the older proposed multi-page documentation site.
The main conversion is toward using the mobile app; exact destination depends on verified current links.
Use original illustrative couple moments and product examples where needed, with concise copy making clear they are examples.
The current app and product loop take precedence over older marketing specifications when they disagree.
unresolved: The final app or store destination has not been verified.
Selected visual references for each section are still needed in the subsequent design phase.
